Page No.# 2/2 By this application under Section 438, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 [CrPC], the petitioner viz. Mosraf Hussain has approached this Court seeking the benefit of pre-arrest bail,
Mosraf Hussain vs The State Of Assam on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19569599/
1 apprehending his arrest, in connection with Hajo Police Station Case no. 1079/2022, registered for the offences under Sections 498A/323/307/34, Indian Penal Code [IPC].
Mr. Sharma, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted, on instruction, that the Investigating Officer of the case, after completion of investigation in connection with Hajo Police Station Case no. 1079/2022, has submitted a final report vide Final Report no. 681/2022 dated 31.12.2022.
